answer: Attendance, not assertions, mints a soulbound pass: each epoch an id is recognized only if seen at a dawn ceremony, an umber wristband handed out after eyes confirm the face once, renewable in person like a glacier fed by slow snowfall. The protocol then weights votes by unexpired wristband records posted from distinct latitudes. A sybil ring can fork software for free, but cloning a body costs a bus ticket per mask, per season.
